reviews.title: What did it turn into
reviews.text:
I just wanted to learn a word of the day. I got excited about the personalization, but it feels more like a gimmick to keep me on the app versus actually learning.

Last time I downloaded I had the word of the day clearly there. Not forcing me to unlock it and play two games. 

Immediate removal and checking out another app.

reviews.title: Profit over people
reviews.text: Thanks for ruining my 665 day streak with this app by updating so you have to watch a 5 min ad before you get your word unless you pay for a subscription. Ads are sometimes reasonable but these ones are all unreasonably long and there’s multiple. Plus the words aren’t good anymore .. It’s insulting because it thinks i’m illiterate.

reviews.title: I HATE THE APP’S NEW PLATFORM & CHANGES FOR FREE SUBSCRIBERS‼️
reviews.text:
This used to be my favorite game app. I played every single day. I played all the available games. Now it seems a free subscriber is locked out of the majority of the day’s goals. Can’t keep a streak like before. Of which I had a very long one going! Now that too is gone. All free subscribers get are 2 daily goals that they can do out of the 6! Locked out of the rest. 
Why?

reviews.title: ‘Missed a word’ -edit
reviews.text:
Everyday I log onto the app, not always at the same time of day, but the app acts like I missed a word even though I didn’t! I’m logging in, looking at the definition and story, yet it tells me every other day I missed a word. 

This is an edit but I have a 116 day streak and again I don’t log in at the same time every morning and yet I’m still ‘missing a word of the day!’

reviews.title: Thanks for making it worse
reviews.text: Well I liked the app before, it was simple and I just looked at the words of the day, did the gaps and the short word quiz and was done. Quick and easy. So naturally they have to screw that up and make it more confusing and difficult. There are all these other games now that I don’t have time to mess with. Also when I got to the end of the gaps it would just tell me the word so I knew, now it wants me to watch and ad or pay I guess?? Know your market. I already pay for this app, I don’t have all day to spend screwing around on here, it was fine the way it was before. I ll just switch to another app after my subscription is done on here.

reviews.title: Ick
reviews.text:
I have a learning disability and can’t spell.  The game used to be OK for me as I could skip gaps and still do well.
Now if there is a misspelling, in the game where one has to put in the word that goes with the first word, it automatically takes away a point if spelled wrong.  I need time to read the word and try to correct spelling.
  The game with Vincent has no more parts.  Once at the end, there is nothing.
  I have actually I somehow had two subscriptions that end next year.  I cancelled the renewal.
  I looked forward to this game every day.
  I no longer even like it.

reviews.title: Beware…this app has serious bugs.
reviews.text:
Beware…this app has serious bugs, and the developers have no interest in fixing them!
I joined this app in August 2024 and I have noticed one very consistent pattern. Whenever I have a high streak, the app tells me that I have missed a day when I know I have not. It then forces for me to watch ads, which wouldn’t be an issue if it fixed the glitch/problem, but, it doesn’t. This has been going on for a while now and I have reached out to the app’s technical support team, and no one has ever responded to my messages. I really like this app, but it won’t allow you maintain a high streak, which is unfortunate, because it seems the app developers are way more concerned with making money from ads. I am seriously rethinking this app now.

reviews.title: 🌸Your Vocabulary is talking Behind Your Back ! 🌸 Easy to learn new words for better conversation😀
reviews.text:
Have you ever had a conversation where you just can’t think of the “exact” word to use to make your point? Even worse, have you ever found yourself in a predicament where  you used a word that caused further confusion rather than clarification; or have you used a word only to find out you
 either/or pronounced it incorrectly or used it within the wrong context? 
🌺 YES ! Whether we like it or not, our vocabulary is talking behind our backs and how we speak reveals to others volumes. If you are looking for a simple, quick, and effortless way to introduce yourself new and precise words and to make everyday communication transparent, this is the app for you ! 🌺
The Word of the Day App is an easy and quick way to expose yourself to a higher tier of vocabulary in a way that makes recall a breeze and provides pronunciation too. I love it !!!! 🌺Say what you what you mean and say it without meaningless chatter or wordy phrases. 🌺

reviews.title: Wonderful app all around but…
reviews.text:
This app is really awesome because it incorporates so many aspects of reading comprehension into one place. This includes reading and descriptive definitions to define and provide application of the new words we’re learning. I just wish the developers included a lifetime purchase option. I would totally buy it. A recurring subscription is not in my financial plans atm. The ads feature is nice for unlocking content; adding a feature where two things at a time, such as a word and story, would be great too. Watching adds gets monotonous. Either way I love the app and what it has to offer. I also think adding like a section where one can save correctsentences they made with the words they learned for memory training would be helpful. 

Great app!

reviews.title: Stop with the EXP / Streaks!
reviews.text: This app could be great, but be aware that they have the MOST annoying animations that play out (probably eats up about 15 seconds every time you access the app) for rewards, or EXP, or other ridiculous things that you’re not able to disable. I’ve left them a ton of feedback over the last year, and they haven’t followed up once. Make this configurable please. Otherwise, you have a great experience that is blocked by an addictively designed mechanism that is so stupid that I cannot use the words I want to use. You can do better.

reviews.title: Use of Generative AI in pictures
reviews.text: I downloaded this app primarily for the widget feature, so i can get a word of the day on my home screen and a nice little picture with it too, however I’ve been noticing the past 2 or so images were seemingly AI generated, and part of the appeal for me was having a nice to look at picture on the home-screen. If you don’t bring back the human made photos, could you at least give attribution to the artists? I would love to see more of their work.

reviews.title: Love This App! Streak Reset Randomly
reviews.text: I have used this app for four years or so. I’ve adored it and I love the beautiful illustrations for every day. It’s nice to support non-AI art nowadays. My only gripe is that I had a streak of 599 days a number of years ago, and when I opened the app the streak reset for no reason and I was so distraught that I stopped using the app entirely until a couple of months ago when I picked it back up. I wish there was a way to restore that streak, but it’s gone. One remark is that if you have the app for long enough, you will see reused words and illustrations. I’ve only seen one so far so it’s fairly non-problematic.
